value.rationale: An exact single-arc fault in highly regular shift-overlap networks reverses complete extinction into tunable m+2 periodic motion, with explicit growing recurrent dimension, sharp transient and complete orbit census for all finite characteristic-two fields. The striking qualitative change and exact infinite-size robustness law, not just a familiar unmodified de Bruijn spectrum, motivates the invariant.
